about: The Workbench icons of the BSDCardGames drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art in art/ is drawn by amiga/icons/draw_art.py (bsd-games has no pictures); the badge is Cribbage's. BSDCardGames-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BSDCardGames.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for COPYING.txt.
